home_rows.advantage: Loose black cinder fills the channel floor, so the burrow bulge hides in the grain and every line rides this channel in the first 30 s.
home_rows.counter: Carve the channel wall: a ball on the wall band is off the floor and the burrow can't reach it (floor_rule.gd), and the rope fan's rings hang on the band; or slam the marker, and the codex burrow_lane pays for the side roll.

home_rows.advantage: The flooded gallery is the darkest place in the park, so the lure bloom is the only light and it bends a slow ball toward the pool edge.
home_rows.counter: Rivet's line sprints the gallery at cruise or faster, which the lure never touches (lamp_swarm.gd:7-9); a cruise ram scatters the lamps.

home_rows.advantage: The drift is narrow and straight, so a rig leading the ball by 0.8 s (drill_crew.gd:11) puts its 3 m ring dead on the line.
home_rows.counter: Ride the drift wall: the rig's ring bores the floor and a carving ball is off it (floor_rule.gd); the wall ropes carry you past, the timber sets every 6 m are claw and harpoon anchors, or smash the rig mid-bore.

home_rows.advantage: The brood's outer cells line the gallery ring above the caisson, so drones dive from the ring onto a ball pumping the bowl below.
home_rows.counter: Bowl through a forming rack at speed and the drones follow you; lead them into the lamp guard as pins (codex awaiting_operator).

home_rows.advantage: The barge bores straight down into the east haulage, so its crew arrives under the plateau ahead of a ball already in the tubes.
home_rows.counter: The bore shaft it opens is a drop onto the haulage rails; ride it down past the crew, or shoot the mast from the rim.
